features.text: GetVideoProperty: Read video property info by the property name. (GET /video/{name}/videoProperties/{propertyName})
PostAddAudio: Add audio to original video. (POST /video/{name}/addAudio)
PostAppendVideo: Append video to original video. (POST /video/{name}/appendVideo)
GetVideoWithFormat: Export the document into the specified format. (GET /video/{name})
PostConvertVideo: Convert document from request content to format specified. (POST /video/{name}/convert)
PostLoadWebVideo: Loads new video from web into the file with any supported format of data. (POST /video/loadWebVideo)
